briefdescription.para: Validate that a device identifier is legal for an IOCTL.

detaileddescription.para: Requires RPU-only operations to target an RPU core, APU mode operations to target an APU core, and SD DLL reset to target SDIO0. Invalid combinations are logged; no device or register state is changed.

parameterdescription.para: IOCTL operation whose target restrictions are checked.
Device node identifier supplied for the operation.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS for a permitted combination, or XPM_INVALID_DEVICEID for a restricted operation with an invalid target.
Call XPm_ValidateDeviceId instead when fault-injection resistance is required; it invokes this implementation redundantly and compares the results.

briefdescription.para: Validates device ID based on IOCTL operation with fault attack resistance.

simplesect.para: XST_SUCCESS if validation passes, error code otherwise
